en: An archerfish grown to a dog's length in the fen's tea-dark water. It knocks beetles off the roots with a jet of water, and lately it has started aiming higher.
A tree-crab of the mangroves, bark-brown and spotted with lichen. It lives in the prop-roots and drags what it catches into them to eat later.
A leech as flat and long as a ribbon, its underside faintly amber. The Kirru wade the channels with their legs wrapped, and still come home bitten.
